_comment: HAND-AUTHORED HARD NEGATIVES — §6.3's failure mode: 'cards with similar phrasing that do meaningfully different things'. MINED as candidates, but every pair is accepted or rejected by the pilot, because an eval mined from the same regexes training uses would measure only whether training memorised its own supervision. A pair is a FAILURE when a space calls the two cards near-identical. Report 1 - cosine: higher is better. Set `accepted` to true or false; null means unreviewed and the pair is NOT scored. Rejected pairs are KEPT, with their reason: the record of a judgement is worth more than a shorter file, and the next person will otherwise re-mine the same candidates.
